Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Barratt Redrow purchased 3,023,302 ordinary shares for cancellation during 9–13 November 2026 (VWAPs: 9 Nov 331.8390p; 10 Nov 336.2240p; 11 Nov 324.9576p; 12 Nov 334.8995p; 13 Nov 327.8907p) under its £386 million share repurchase programme, bringing aggregate cancellations to date to 45,604,718 shares; following these purchases the company holds no treasury shares and has 1,364,915,535 ordinary shares in issue (total voting rights 1,364,915,535). Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 16 November 2026 16 November 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 9 November 2026 to 13 November 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE").
